content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: JSON is a common representation for HTTP payloads and application boundaries. Reliable APIs define stable resource shapes, validate input, report errors consistently, version contracts carefully, and avoid confusing transport status with payload content.

content_blocks.title: What you will cover

HTTP status codes and JSON payloads. Separating transport status from payload content.. Treat each as part of a workflow: define what the data should mean, represent it consistently, and test how the chosen implementation interprets it.

content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: JSON in HTTP Communication
content_blocks.code:
POST /api/products HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{"name":"Notebook","active":true}
